name: TrustHawk
tagline: Trust ratings for AI companies, not their models
description:
TrustHawk rates AI companies, not their models, on four equal pillars: Safety, Transparency, Security and Privacy. Model benchmarks tell you how capable a model is; TrustHawk looks at the company behind it.

Every finding comes from verified public data, with the same published method for every company. AI only answers fixed factual questions with verbatim quotes from public sources, two independent extractions must agree, and code checks that each quote is really in the saved source. If a pillar lacks enough verified data, the company shows "Not enough data" and is left unrated on that pillar.

Every company page links to its sources. No company pays to be rated or can pay to change its rating, and companies, journalists and readers can request corrections. Free to use, no account needed.
